question:
Solve the following expression.

50 - [20 + (30 - (25 - 5)]
solution:
Given:

50 - [20 + (30 - (25 - 5)] 

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed9c81555cbac7fede0aee4fb4bc3541affcebf9c8ab6dcf458ce0b2d9d0ed7a.png] 

Calculation:

⇒ 50 - [20 + (30 - (25 - 5)] 

⇒ 50 - [20 + (30 - 20)] 

⇒ 50 - [20 + 10] 

⇒ 50 - 30

⇒ 20

**The answer is 20.**
